evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Reduce documentation verbosity while preserving clarity and completeness.
intent.acceptance: Deletion-only removal of one or more exact repeated prose paragraphs within the same heading context, retaining at least one byte-identical occurrence and all distinct paragraphs in order. Do not treat code, links, headings, frontmatter, warnings or Mermaid as disposable paragraphs.

evidence.opportunity: One changed eligible markdown document under docs/src/content/docs, excluding blog, generated frontmatter-full.md and protected files.
filters: Deletion-only removal of one or more exact repeated prose paragraphs within the same heading context, retaining at least one byte-identical occurrence and all distinct paragraphs in order. Do not treat code, links, headings, frontmatter, warnings or Mermaid as disposable paragraphs.

evidence.collection: Offline original Git custody and complete production issue/PR discovery. Bounded candidate cohort; missing originals and Discussions remain gaps, not zero delivery.

model.architecture: Deterministic original-byte native predicates; strict full-goal, semantic usability and attribution remain separate.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no native keep bar or matched costs; bounded cases do not establish full historical coverage.

metrics.name: Native partial outcomes
metrics.formula: Sum accepted content-preserving duplicate occurrences removed across original native cases in [windowStart,windowEnd); null when unassessed.

metrics.name: Full goal completion
metrics.formula: Sum accepted fully verified documentation outcomes across original native cases in [windowStart,windowEnd); null when unassessed.

metrics.name: Verified contribution
metrics.formula: Sum accepted receipt-verified contributed outcomes across original native cases in [windowStart,windowEnd); null when unassessed.

definition.retrospectiveAssessment: Frozen-source fixed-reference predicates can assess historical native facts but cannot establish that later intent was applicable at their time.

historicalClassification.baseline: No comparable pre-adoption native cohort has been established by this bounded study; not an assertion that history is exhausted.

definition.fullAcceptance: Exactly one eligible file improved; source-defined at-least-20-percent bloat reduction plus preserved essential information, links, examples, metadata, diagrams and accurate usable technical content.
limitations: Unknown facts score null, not zero. A bounded accepted case is partial coverage, not a complete repository-period population.
Semantic accuracy, usability, essential facts, examples, links and warnings must be independently established. Reduced size, merged state or generated reports alone never prove full completion.
A non-null bounded count is not evidence of complete repository-period coverage or full-goal attainment.
